description: This Java class defines an immutable event called FeaturePropertyCreated, which is emitted when a property of a feature within a thing is created. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, retrieving details of the event, and serializing to JSON.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class that represents the creation of a feature property within a thing, with methods for instantiation from JSON, property accessors, and JSON serialization.

methods.description: Static methods to deserialize a FeaturePropertyCreated instance from JSON string or object.

methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature related to the event.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the created property.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the created property.
